evidence: judge-context/checks.json: patch_applies=true, commands=[] (no tests run, per the experiment setup).

I applied patch.diff to a scratch copy of the original base with `git apply --check` and `git apply`; both succeeded. The six resulting files (rich/align.py, rich/tree.py, rich/console.py, tests/test_align.py, tests/test_tree.py, CHANGELOG.md) are byte-identical to the generated tree (diff -q).
Against the original snapshot, the generated tree changes exactly these six files (git status shows M for each); no other file is added, removed, or modified.
rich/align.py:157 VerticalCenter sits after Align (ends at 154) and before the `if __name__` guard.
rich/tree.py:155 Tree.__rich_measure__ sits after Tree.__rich_console__ (ends at 153), as the spec requires.
rich/align.py:149-150 Align.__repr__; rich/align.py:92-99 measured-maximum width constraint in Align.__rich_console__; rich/console.py:1205 justify="default" in render options.
rich/align.py:164 `def __init__(self, renderable: "RenderableType") -> None` matches the spec's single positional renderable.
rich/align.py:149 `__repr__(self) -> str`; rich/align.py:167 VerticalCenter.__repr__ returns str.
rich/tree.py:155 `__rich_measure__(self, console, max_width) -> Measurement`, the measurement protocol signature.
rich/console.py print signature is untouched; only the render-options justify value changes (console.py:1197 keeps justify=justify in _collect_renderables, console.py:1205 sets "default").
rich/tree.py:6 adds `from .measure import Measurement`; rich/measure.py:1-5 imports only operator, typing, .errors and .protocol, so there is no import cycle with tree.
rich/align.py adds no imports; Measurement and Constrain were already imported.
The spec says VerticalCenter must not be registered in rich/__init__.py; the patch does not touch it (git status lists only six files).

VerticalCenter inherits JupyterMixin (rich/align.py:157) and implements the render protocol (`__rich_console__`, align.py:170), the measurement protocol (`__rich_measure__`, align.py:188), and `__repr__` (align.py:167).
Tree measurement is picked up by the duck-typed lookup `getattr(renderable, "__rich_measure__")` in rich/measure.py:106.
No third-party or new package dependencies are added; the only new import is the intra-package `rich.measure` import at rich/tree.py:6.
pyproject.toml is unchanged in the generated tree.
Tree measurement logic lives in the Tree class (rich/tree.py:155-178), where the tree structure is known.
Vertical centering lives in rich/align.py VerticalCenter (lines 170-186), alongside Align.
The width constraint is confined to Align.__rich_console__ rendering (align.py:92-99); Align.__rich_measure__ (align.py:152-154) is unchanged, as the spec requires.
Justify handling is confined to Console.print render options (console.py:1205).
Measurement is obtained through Measurement.get (align.py:92, tree.py:170), the existing measurement entry point, not by reaching into internals.
Vertical layout uses the public console.render_lines (align.py:173) and console.size.height (align.py:175), matching the spec's "read height only from the console size property".
Align still renders via console.render(Constrain(...), options) (align.py:97-99), the existing mechanism; no parallel rendering path is introduced.
Tree.__rich_measure__ reads only node.label, node.children and node.expanded (tree.py:170-176), as the spec requires, and passes max_width unchanged to child labels (tree.py:170).
Indentation is added only to the measured widths (tree.py:171-173), not to the max_width argument.
VerticalCenter emits padding as newline Segments (align.py:181, 185) rather than space-filled lines, matching the spec's constraint.
VerticalCenter docstring (align.py:158-162) is a one-line summary plus an Args block typed like Align's (align.py:19-30).
CHANGELOG.md:8-15 marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased, adds an Added subheading with the two entries, and keeps the existing STDIN entry (line 10), as the spec requires.
Tests follow the file's direct-assert pytest style and sit beside related tests (tests/test_align.py:92-115, tests/test_tree.py:39-46); imports are added in place (test_align.py:6, test_tree.py:2).
Minor and non-blocking: tree.py:155 leaves `Measurement` unquoted while other annotations in that file are quoted; align.py uses the same unquoted style, so this is consistent with the repo.

Tree measurement: iterative explicit stack, level counter from 0, indent=level*4, descent only when expanded and has children, returns Measurement(minimum, maximum) (tree.py:155-178). A single-node tree yields its own label measurement.

VerticalCenter rendering: render_lines with pad=False (align.py:173), height from console.size.height (175), top=(height-n)//2 (177), bottom=height-top-n-1 (178), newline segments only when positive (180-186).
VerticalCenter measurement delegates to Measurement.get with max_width (align.py:188-190).
Reprs: `Align(<renderable!r>, <align!r>)` (align.py:150); VerticalCenter omits alignment (align.py:168).
Align width constraint: measured maximum with no max_width (align.py:92); no explicit width uses it, explicit W uses min(measured, W) (align.py:93-96); measurement unchanged.
Console.print: justify still passed into collection (console.py:1197), render options get "default" (console.py:1205).
